text: おれが　ちょっと　ゆだん　した　すきに…　くそう！

structure.jp: おれが　ちょっと　ゆだん　した　すきに…
structure.en: in the moment I let my guard down a little...

patterns.name: 〜すきに
patterns.span: ゆだん　した　すきに
patterns.explanation: A verb plus すきに means 'in the short opening while that happened', when someone takes advantage of it. ゆだん　した　すきに = 'in the moment I let my guard down'.
